fetch_all.description: Fetch every playlist (up to 500), continuing FROM offset rather than restarting at 0. limit is the page size. Note: library tools' fetch_all instead ignores offset — contracts differ between modules (#110).

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object
